001package dev.nandi0813.api.Interface;
002
003import dev.nandi0813.api.Enum.HotbarLayout;
004import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
005import org.bukkit.inventory.ItemStack;
006
007/**
008 * An addon item in a core hotbar layout. Implemented by addons and registered with
009 * {@link HotbarItemRegistry#register(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, HotbarItem)}.
010 */
011public interface HotbarItem {
012
013    /**
014     * Unique id, lowercase [a-z0-9_-].
015     * @return The id, never null
016     */
017    String getId();
018
019    /**
020     * The layout this item belongs to.
021     * @return The layout, never null
022     */
023    HotbarLayout getLayout();
024
025    /**
026     * Player inventory slot, 0-35 (0-8 = hotbar).
027     * @return The slot
028     */
029    int getSlot();
030
031    /**
032     * Item for this player; return null to not give it to them (e.g. permission check). Called on the main thread.
033     * @param player The player
034     * @return The item, or null to not give it
035     */
036    ItemStack getItem(Player player);
037
038    /**
039     * Called on the main thread when the player right-clicks with the item in hand.
040     * @param player The player
041     */
042    void onUse(Player player);
043
044}
